short_description: Meridian Bank — a regional bank's attrition-and-next-best-action rescue. A competitor rate promotion sent a cluster of the bank's most valuable, longest-tenured customers into elevated attrition risk on maturing CDs and high-balance savings. A relationship-manager app reads governed customer-360 data at low latency, a next-best-action recommendation ranks the move (retention offer / cross-sell / RM outreach) per at-risk customer, and an EVP approves — turning governed lakehouse data into a relationship action, with PII minimized and the assistant's AI spend bounded, logged, and defensible to a regulator.
